question: Do group payment-policy ranges and anticipated harmonization explain persistent differences in payment execution?
source_definition: Reporting Fields March2025 PDF12 and21: minimum/maximum are extrema of each legal entity's separately calculated modal SME payment term, not tied aggregate modes or forecast confidence intervals. Fields shown when controlled entities exist.

descriptive_outcomes: Next actual minimum and maximum shifts
Group payment days and contract-relative on-time share changes
forecast_benchmark: Forecast spread MAE compared on identical rows to unchanged-current-spread benchmark; ABN-equal weighting and paired ABN bootstrap; fixed seed20261107,1999draws

statistical_design: First report event counts, timing, revision and endpoint consistency. falsification_and_alternatives: Convergence from raising minimum terms versus lowering maximum terms
Ownership/perimeter changes and shifts in which subsidiaries make SME payments
